variants.name: Tuna 100 g
variants.about_this_item: MONGE FRESH delicious pate with fresh tuna is a complete food developed to support your pet's well-being on a daily basis. The recipe contains no hydrogenated fats. The fluffy and tasty pate from the Fresh line is the ideal meal for small dogs and a treat for larger ones. Monge Fresh is made in Italy, not tested on animals and has no artificial additives or colours.
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: Meat and animal derivatives 50%, fish and fish derivatives 30% (fresh tuna 10%), minerals.

Analytical constituents: Crude protein 9,0%, crude fibres 0,5%, crude fat 7,0%, crude ash 1,2%. Moisture 82,0%.

Additives: NUTRITIONAL ADDITIVES: Vitamin A (Retinyl Acetate) 3000 IU, Vitamin D3 400 IU, Vitamin E (all rac-alpha-tocopheryl-acetate) 15 mg.
